verses.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ צוּרִ֗י הַֽמְלַמֵּ֣ד יָדַ֣י לַקְרָ֑ב אֶ֝צְבְּעֹותַ֗י לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ مُبَارَكٌ ٱلرَّبُّ صَخْرَتِي، ٱلَّذِي يُعَلِّمُ يَدَيَّ ٱلْقِتَالَ وَأَصَابِعِي ٱلْحَرْبَ.
verses.en: A Psalm of David. Blessed be the LORD my Rock, who traineth my hands for war, and my fingers for battle;
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David. Blessed [be] the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, [and] my fingers to fight:
verses.web: By David. Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

verses.he: חַסְדִּ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִי֮ מִשְׂגַּבִּ֪י וּֽמְפַלְטִ֫י לִ֥י מָ֭גִנִּי וּבֹ֣ו חָסִ֑יתִי הָרֹודֵ֖ד עַמִּ֣י תַחְתָּֽי׃
verses.ar: رَحْمَتِي وَمَلْجَإِي، صَرْحِي وَمُنْقِذِي، مِجَنِّي وَٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، ٱلْمُخْضِعُ شَعْبِي تَحْتِي.
verses.en: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and He in whom I take refuge; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.kjv: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and [he] in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.web: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، أَيُّ شَيْءٍ هُوَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ حَتَّى تَعْرِفَهُ، أَوِ ٱبْنُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ حَتَّى تَفْتَكِرَ بِهِ؟
verses.en: LORD, what is man, that Thou takest knowledge of him? or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him?
verses.kjv: LORD, what [is] man, that thou takest knowledge of him! [or] the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.web: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

verses.he: אָ֭דָם לַהֶ֣בֶל דָּמָ֑ה יָ֝מָ֗יו כְּצֵ֣ל עֹובֵֽר׃
verses.ar: ٱلْإِنْسَانُ أَشْبَهَ نَفْخَةً. أَيَّامُهُ مِثْلُ ظِلٍّ عَابِرٍ.
verses.en: Man is like unto a breath; his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.kjv: Man is like to vanity: his days [are] as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.web: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

verses.he: יְ֭הוָה הַט־שָׁמֶ֣יךָ וְתֵרֵ֑ד גַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וֽ͏ְיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، طَأْطِئْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَٱنْزِلِ. ٱلْمِسِ ٱلْجِبَالَ فَتُدَخِّنَ.
verses.en: O LORD, bow Thy heavens, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
verses.kjv: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.web: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

verses.he: בְּרֹ֣וק בָּ֭רָק וּתְפִיצֵ֑ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗יךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃
verses.ar: أَبْرِقْ بُرُوقًا وَبَدِّدْهُمْ. أَرْسِلْ سِهَامَكَ وَأَزْعِجْهُمْ.
verses.en: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; send out Thine arrows, and discomfit them.
verses.kjv: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.web: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

verses.he: שְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶ֗יךָ מִמָּ֫רֹ֥ום פְּצֵ֣נִי וְ֭הַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר׃
verses.ar: أَرْسِلْ يَدَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعَلَاءِ. أَنْقِذْنِي وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلْمِيَاهِ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ، مِنْ أَيْدِي ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ
verses.en: Stretch forth Thy hands from on high; rescue me, and deliver me out of many waters, out of the hand of strangers;
verses.kjv: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.web: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ تَكَلَّمَتْ أَفْوَاهُهُمْ بِٱلْبَاطِلِ، وَيَمِينُهُمْ يَمِينُ كَذِبٍ.
verses.en: Whose mouth speaketh falsehood, and their right hand is a right hand of lying.
verses.kjv: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood.
verses.web: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.he: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ אָשִׁ֣ירָה לָּ֑ךְ בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שֹׂ֗ור אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.ar: يَا ٱللهُ، أُرَنِّمُ لَكَ تَرْنِيمَةً جَدِيدَةً. بِرَبَابٍ ذَاتِ عَشَرَةِ أَوْتَارٍ أُرَنِّمُ لَكَ.
verses.en: O God, I will sing a new song unto Thee, upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto Thee;
verses.kjv: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery [and] an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.web: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

verses.he: הַנֹּותֵ֥ן תְּשׁוּעָ֗ה לַמְּלָ֫כִ֥ים הַ֭פֹּוצֶה אֶת־דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדֹּ֗ו מֵחֶ֥רֶב רָעָֽה׃
verses.ar: ٱلْمُعْطِي خَلَاصًا لِلْمُلُوكِ. ٱلْمُنْقِذُ دَاوُدَ عَبْدَهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّيْفِ ٱلسُّوءِ.
verses.en: Who givest salvation unto kings, who rescuest David Thy servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.kjv: [It is he] that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.web: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

verses.he: פְּצֵ֥נִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי֮ מִיַּ֪ד בְּֽנֵי־נֵ֫כָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.ar: أَنْقِذْنِي وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ أَيْدِي ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ، ٱلَّذِينَ تَكَلَّمَتْ أَفْوَاهُهُمْ بِٱلْبَاطِلِ، وَيَمِينُهُمْ يَمِينُ كَذِبٍ.
verses.en: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of strangers, whose mouth speaketh falsehood, and their right hand is a right hand of lying.
verses.kjv: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood:
verses.web: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּנֵ֨ינוּ ׀ כִּנְטִעִים֮ מְגֻדָּלִ֪ים בִּֽנְעוּרֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּנֹותֵ֥ינוּ כְזָוִיֹּ֑ת מְ֝חֻטָּבֹ֗ות תַּבְנִ֥ית הֵיכָֽל׃
verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَكُونَ بَنُونَا مِثْلَ ٱلْغُرُوسِ ٱلنَّامِيَةِ فِي شَبِيبَتِهَا. بَنَاتُنَا كَأَعْمِدَةِ ٱلزَّوَايَا مَنْحُوتَاتٍ حَسَبَ بِنَاءِ هَيْكَلٍ.
verses.en: We whose sons are as plants grown up in their youth; whose daughters are as corner-pillars carved after the fashion of a palace;
verses.kjv: That our sons [may be] as plants grown up in their youth; [that] our daughters [may be] as corner stones, polished [after] the similitude of a palace:
verses.web: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

verses.he: מְזָוֵ֣ינוּ מְלֵאִים֮ מְפִיקִ֥ים מִזַּ֗ן אֶ֫ל־זַ֥ן צֹאונֵ֣נוּ מַ֭אֲלִיפֹות מְרֻבָּבֹ֗ות בְּחוּצֹותֵֽינוּ׃
verses.ar: أَهْرَاؤُنَا مَلآنَةً تَفِيضُ مِنْ صِنْفٍ فَصِنْفٍ. أَغْنَامُنَا تُنْتِجُ أُلُوفًا وَرِبْوَاتٍ فِي شَوَارِعِنَا.
verses.en: Whose garners are full, affording all manner of store; whose sheep increase by thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
verses.kjv: [That] our garners [may be] full, affording all manner of store: [that] our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.web: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

verses.he: אַלּוּפֵ֗ינוּ מְֽסֻבָּ֫לִ֥ים אֵֽין־פֶּ֭רֶץ וְאֵ֣ין יֹוצֵ֑את וְאֵ֥ין צְ֝וָחָ֗ה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.ar: بَقَرُنَا مُحَمَّلَةً. لَا ٱقْتِحَامَ وَلَا هُجُومَ، وَلَا شَكْوَى فِي شَوَارِعِنَا.
verses.en: Whose oxen are well laden; with no breach, and no going forth, and no outcry in our broad places;
verses.kjv: [That] our oxen [may be] strong to labour; [that there be] no breaking in, nor going out; that [there be] no complaining in our streets.
verses.web: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לֹּ֑ו אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֶׁיֲהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلشَّعْبِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُ كَهَذَا. طُوبَى لِلشَّعْبِ ٱلَّذِي ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُهُ.
verses.en: Happy is the people that is in such a case. Yea, happy is the people whose God is the LORD.
verses.kjv: Happy [is that] people, that is in such a case: [yea], happy [is that] people, whose God [is] the LORD.
verses.web: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
